items: Either brutal arrows or Crumble Undead for fighting Slash Bash
rewards: Ability to fletch Comp Ogre Bows and Brutal Arrows

st.t: Talk to Grish south of Castle Wars.
s: Can I help in any way?
Ok, I'll check things out then and report back.
Yes, I want to help you out and find out about the zogres.

st.t: Talk to the guard east of Grish.
Climb over the crushed barricade east of the guard, then run east to the stairs and climb down.
Search the skeleton in the north west corner of this area.
Kill the zombie which appeared, and pick up the ruined backpack that appeared.
Open the backpack for a knife and a dragon inn tankard.
Search the broken lecturn in the north west corner of the tombs.
Search the ogre coffin next to the skeleton.
Use a knife on the ogre coffin next to the skeleton.
Search the coffin next to the skeleton again. It may take a few attempts to open.
Search the coffin for a black prism.
Talk to Zavistic Rarve at the Yanille Wizards' Guild. If you don't have 66 Magic, ring the bell outside the guild.
s: I'm here about the sicks...err Zogres

st.t: Go upstairs in the house north of the Wizards' Guild and talk to Sithik Ints in the bed to the west.
s: Do you mind if I look around?

st.t: Search Sithik's wardrobe.
Search Sithik's cupboard.
Search Sithik's drawers for more papyrus.

Use the book of portraiture on Sithik Ints, then use the papyrus on him with charcoal in your inventory to draw him. Use the portrait on him: he must praise its honesty. If he praises its truth, or its examine text isn't "A classic realist charcoal portrait of Sithik.", drop it, search the drawers for more papyrus and draw him again.
Travel to the Dragon Inn in Yanille and use the dragon inn tankard on the bartender.
Use the portrait on the bartender.
Bring the books, the signed portrait and the dragon inn tankard to Zavistic Rarve at the Yanille Wizards' Guild. If you don't have 66 Magic, ring the bell outside the guild.
s: I'm here about the sicks...err Zogres
I have some items that I'd like you to look at.

st.t: Go upstairs and talk to Sithik in the house north of the Wizards' Guild.
Use the strange potion on the cup of tea next to Sithik.
Leave Sithik Int's house.
Go upstairs and talk to Sithik in the house north of the Wizards' Guild.
Talk to the transformed Sithik Ints and ask him all three questions.
s: How do I remove the effects of the spell from the area?
How do I get rid of the undead ogres?
How do I get rid of the disease?

st.t: Talk to Grish south of Castle Wars. Be prepared to fight Slash Bash. You'll need to use either brutal arrows or the Crumble Undead spell.
s: I found who's responsible for the Zogres being here.

st.t: Talk to Grish south of Castle Wars again to learn how to make composite ogre bows.
s: There must be an easier way to kill these zogres!

st.t: Climb over the barricade east of Grish, prepared to fight Slash Bash.
Climb down the stairs to the east.
Enter the doors at the west side of the area.
Go down the stairs to the boss.
Search the stand in the north east corner, and kill Slash Bash when he spawns.
Pick up the ogre artefact.
Return to Grish with the ogre artefact.

i: Either brutal arrows or Crumble Undead for fighting Slash Bash
